:::{#exr-linearly-independent-practice}
#### Testing whether two features and their total are linearly independent

A table of data that stores two features and also their total
holds redundant information,
which the test below detects.
Let

$$
\vecf{v}_1 = \sbmat{1 \\ 2 \\ 0},
\qquad
\vecf{v}_2 = \sbmat{0 \\ 1 \\ 1},
\qquad
\vecf{v}_3 = \sbmat{1 \\ 3 \\ 1}.
$$

Are $\vecf{v}_1$, $\vecf{v}_2$ and $\vecf{v}_3$ [linearly independent](#def-linearly-independent)?

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Compare $\vecf{v}_3$ with $\vecf{v}_1 + \vecf{v}_2$.

:::

:::
